beats.narration_text: Let's recap with Claude. Four entrances: a spring that settles, an overshoot that squashes on landing, a per-path stagger across forty-seven paths, and a draw-on stroke where the outline traces before the fill floods. All four say arrival — they say it at very different volumes.

Your turn. Here's the prompt, verbatim: take my logo SVG, run it through spring entrance, draw-on stroke, and stagger — and tell me which one reads as deliberate versus which one just looks busy. That last question is the actual design work.
Musinique logo, in motion. Part one. Liam, in for Bear.
